log: 'A critic endpoint response shows its changes against the checked original'

eval: els.prompt.value = 'a red fox'; promptReplaced(); checkPrompt().then(() => askCritic());

log: 'The gist of the change shows with the diff closed: outside the details, a few words of each change, marked as the diff marks them'

expect: (() => { const gist = els.criticResult.querySelector('.critic-gist'); return !els.criticResult.querySelector('.critic-changes').open && !gist.closest('details') && gist.previousElementSibling === els.criticResult.querySelector('.critic-changes') && gist.textContent === 'Added Rewritten:' && gist.querySelector('ins').textContent === 'Rewritten:' && gist.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; })()

log: 'The gist names changes as a reader would: a word replaced is one change, edits only a space or a mark keeps apart are one, words put elsewhere are a move, and the verb is said once for a run of the same kind'

expect: changeGist(promptChanges('a red fox, red fur', 'a blue fox, red fur')).innerHTML === 'Changed <del>red</del> → <ins>blue</ins>' && changeGist(promptChanges('one two three four five', 'uno two tres four cinco')).textContent === 'Changed one → uno · three → tres · five → cinco' && changeGist(promptChanges('one two three four five six seven', 'uno two tres four cinco six siete')).textContent === 'Changed one → uno · three → tres · five → cinco · …' && changeGist(promptChanges('a  fox', 'a fox')).textContent === 'Changed spacing'

changeGist(promptChanges('A quiet harbour town at dawn with no people on the pier, a wooden sign that says open', 'An empty harbour town at dawn, a deserted pier, a wooden sign reading "OPEN"')).textContent === 'Changed A quiet → An empty · with no people… → a deserted · that says open → reading "OPEN"' && changeGist(promptChanges('a cat on a mat, soft light, film grain', 'a ginger cat curled on a woven mat, soft morning light, film grain')).textContent === 'Added ginger · curled · woven · …' && changeGist(promptChanges('masterpiece, 1girl, green hair', '1girl, green hair, masterpiece')).innerHTML === 'Moved masterpiece' && changeGist(promptChanges('a, b, c', 'a, c')).textContent === 'Removed b' && changeGist(promptChanges('a fox', 'a fox, film grain')).textContent === 'Added film grain' && changeGist(promptChanges('a fox, b', 'a fox; b')).textContent === 'Changed , → ;'

log: 'Exact differences survive repeated words, escaped tags, spaces, punctuation, CJK and emoji'

expect: [['a red fox, red fur', 'a blue fox, red fur'], ['a, b, a', 'b, a, a'], ['series ' + String.fromCharCode(92) + '(game' + String.fromCharCode(92) + ')', 'series (game)'], ['写着OPEN 😀', '写着CLOSED 🦊'], ['a  fox' + String.fromCharCode(10), 'a fox '], ['', 'new'], ['old', ''], ['same', 'same'], [String.fromCharCode(92).repeat(4000), '/'.repeat(4000)]].every(([a, b]) => { const parts = promptChanges(a, b); return parts.filter((p) => p.kind !== 'added').map((p) => p.text).join('') === a && parts.filter((p) => p.kind !== 'removed').map((p) => p.text).join('') === b; })
